headlines.headline: June CPI 3.1% Fuels Fed Cut Bets — Russell 2000 Rallies 4.2% in Two Sessions
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive template — June CPI prototype for IWM's CPI-beta; showed that 4.2% 2-day IWM rally repeats when CPI cools, establishing IWM as CPI-duration trade.

headlines.headline: IWM Sees $1.1B Weekly Inflow — Largest Since March as Rotation Talk Builds
